# Vento Labs

> Vento Labs is an AI automation agency (Vento Labs Pte. Ltd., registered in Singapore, UEN 202504485G, working remotely from Lisbon). We design and build custom AI agents that cut operating costs, automate workflows, and scale businesses without adding headcount. Every engagement starts with a free 2-week pilot: we build the first AI agent at no cost.

Key facts:
- Founded: 2025. Founder & lead engineer: Alexey Nagorny (alexey@ventolabs.com).
- Stack: Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, CrewAI, n8n, Make.com, MCP servers. Self-hosted deployments — client data stays in the client's infrastructure.
- Typical timelines: basic AI agent in 3–7 days; process automation in 1–3 weeks; company-wide AI platform in 2–4 weeks.
- Typical running costs: AI model usage $20–200/month, paid directly to providers with no markup.
- AI Platform pricing: Pilot from $3,000 setup + $500/month; Scale from $8,000 setup + $2,000/month; Enterprise custom.
- Booking: https://cal.com/ventolabs/30min (30-minute discovery call, free).
- Languages: English (default), German (/de/), Spanish (/es/), Russian (/ru/).

## Services

- [AI Agents](https://ventolabs.com/services/ai-assistant/): Custom self-hosted AI agents on Claude Agent SDK, LangGraph, CrewAI. Telegram, WhatsApp, LinkedIn, email integration; computer-use; any LLM backend including local models.
- [AI Automation](https://ventolabs.com/services/ai-automation/): Intelligent workflow automation with n8n and Make.com — lead qualification, data sync, reporting, CRM/email/chat integrations.
- [AI Consulting & Training](https://ventolabs.com/services/ai-training/): Team enablement — Claude Code, Cursor, MCP servers setup; hands-on workshops; adoption measured at 30 and 60 days.
- [AI Platform](https://ventolabs.com/services/ai-workspace/): Company-wide AI operating system — dedicated agents per team, Knowledge Vault, role-based access, usage/ROI reporting.

## AI infrastructure

- [AI Data Centers](https://ventolabs.com/data-centers/): End-to-end development of AI data centers for investors and owners — deciding what to build, site search, securing land and grid capacity, transmission interconnection, modular construction, commissioning, and operation. Typical projects 10–100+ MW, phased. Modular deployment in 3–6 months against 24–36 for conventional construction; target PUE below 1.3; liquid-cooled racks up to 100 kW. Engagement structures: turnkey build you own, build-to-suit against a signed offtake, or joint venture. Sites currently in diligence or under evaluation in Texas, the US Midwest (MISO), and Sweden. Counterparty names, exact addresses, and commercial terms are not published — the underlying materials are under confidentiality agreements.

## Client results

- [Case studies](https://ventolabs.com/cases/): Zigmund Online (online therapy): patient response time cut from 4 hours to under 2 minutes, booking conversion +40%, 200+ conversations handled daily. NoConcept (e-commerce, 3,000+ SKUs): lead response 6 hours → 8 minutes, 25+ hours/week saved. ASG Compute (cloud infrastructure): 13 AI agents deployed across 5 departments in 4 weeks, AI spend −35%.
- [ArbitrAI](https://arbitrai.tech/): Vento Labs' own LegalTech product — an AI platform for Russian bankruptcy trustees (deadline control under the insolvency law, AI-drafted filings, transaction analysis). Results: daily deadline monitoring 2–3 hours → under 20 minutes, 99.9% of statutory publications filed on time, document prep 6× faster.

## Product directions

- [Content Factory](https://ventolabs.com/cases/content-factory/): Turns e-commerce catalogs into daily discovery content — lifestyle visuals, carousels, short videos, AI presenters.
- [Supplier Agent](https://ventolabs.com/cases/supplier-agent/): Reads supplier emails, chats and price lists; extracts SKUs, prices, stock; updates catalogs by rules with approval flows.
- [1C Agent](https://ventolabs.com/cases/erp-agent/): An AI developer for 1C, the dominant ERP platform in the Russian-speaking market. The IT director or head of department describes a task in plain business language; the agent returns a change plan and writes it only after that plan is approved. Changes land in configuration extensions, so the standard 1C core is never modified and vendor updates keep working. Full audit log of command, action and result; pilot in 2–4 weeks; self-hosted ready. Russian-market product: the en/de/es URLs are short localized summaries, the full case study is Russian-only at /ru/cases/erp-agent/.
- [Bankruptcy AI](https://ventolabs.com/cases/bankruptcy-agent/): AI platform for Russian arbitration trustees («арбитражные управляющие») working under insolvency law 127-FZ — reports to the creditors' meeting and to the court on the statutory forms, procedural filings citing current Supreme Court practice, statutory deadline control, and debtor transaction analysis across the public registries and bank statements. The platform drafts; the trustee reviews, signs with a qualified electronic signature and files. Self-hosted inside the trustee's own perimeter, NDA before any data is connected; subscription from USD 2,500/month. This is the same solution Vento Labs now also develops as the standalone product ArbitrAI (see Client results above). Russian-market product: the en/de/es URLs are short localized summaries, the full page is Russian-only at /ru/cases/bankruptcy-agent/.
